summary: Decompose god function validate_vql_chat_target in photo_vql_validation

delivery.outcome: Decompose validate_vql_chat_target in src/koru/integrations/photo_vql_validation.py (PLF-053): bind the seven-field tuple unpack (_target_geometry) once as a TargetGeometry NamedTuple, move the app_match/label_ok/element-size derivations into _collect_vql_validation_errors/_live_vql_validation_errors, extract _target_is_map and the audit report literal into _vql_chat_validation_report, and make _target_bounds_size return a BoundsSize NamedTuple, dropping validate_vql_chat_target from CC=13 / fan-out=11 / mutations=23 to CC=3 / fan-out<=8 / mutations=5 (god-function thresholds: fan-out > 10, mutations > 6, CC > 12) with every touched or new helper under the same thresholds, while keeping the public validate_vql_chat_target signature, its exact 12-key result dict, and all module __all__ exports byte-identical for every input.
nonGoals: Changing the validate_vql_chat_target signature, result-dict keys or any validation predicate/warning string
Refactoring validate_chat_coords_for_ide (pre-existing fan-out/mutation exceedance in the same file; lower severity, not the smell reported by PLF-053)
Extracting photo_vql_validation.py into a new module or touching vdisplay_client.py / photo_vql_target.py facades

architecture.decision: Return NamedTuples from _target_geometry (TargetGeometry) and _target_bounds_size (BoundsSize) and bind them as single locals, because code2llm double-counts every tuple-unpack assignment target (the 7-name unpack alone contributed 14 of the 23 mutations) and also counts each .append/.extend call as a mutation; the dict literal's two conditional expressions and method-or-None derivations move into _vql_chat_validation_report so CC and mutations drop together. Private helper signatures (_collect_vql_validation_errors, _live_vql_validation_errors) are module-internal: grep shows no importer or monkeypatch target outside photo_vql_validation.py, while validate_vql_chat_target stays late-bound through the vdisplay_client facade and __all__ unchanged.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit to restore the single inline validate_vql_chat_target body.

commands: python3 -c "from code2llm.api import analyze; r = analyze('src/koru/integrations'); rows = [(s.name, s.line) for s in r.smells if s.file.endswith('photo_vql_validation.py')]; print(rows)"
validation.evidence: The code2llm smell list for photo_vql_validation.py no longer contains 'God Function: validate_vql_chat_target' and no touched/new helper (TargetGeometry construction, _target_bounds_size, _target_geometry, _target_is_map, _vql_element_size_ok, _collect_vql_validation_errors, _live_vql_validation_errors, _vql_chat_validation_report) appears as a god function.

All existing photo VQL validation/orchestrator/drive tests pass unchanged (orchestrator monkeypatches validate_vql_chat_target on the vdisplay_client facade, which keeps the same public signature), plus one new regression test asserting the exact full 12-key result dict for a representative target.
Governance gate passes with 0 errors from the ticket worktree.
